What we did (timeline):
- 09:50 PT: Enabled per-route soft QPS caps and paused identified non-critical job per VaultBank ops request.

- 10:25 PT: Applied prefix/KV prioritized caching for payment prefix set (hit rate recovered to ~91%).
- 10:40 PT: Authorized a 2-hour emergency burst allocation — consumed approx. 1.7 hours before load subsided.

Impact: Payments recovered to baseline latency within ~35 minutes after mitigations. We saw ~0.9% residual error rate on very high tail requests; customer-facing SLA effect: short window of degraded success rate.

3) Product ask: prioritize a scheduler circuit-breaker that can automatically shed non-critical routes when reserved headroom falls below threshold (Marcus, please queue as P1).
